title: Finsbury Park Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, flood hazards, and essential supply points for Finsbury Park.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Whittington Hospital: Magdala Avenue, N19 5NF. From Finsbury Park station: ~30 min walk west along Stroud Green Road and Hanley Road (~1.5 miles), or take bus W7 or 210 west towards Archway (~15 mins).
- North Middlesex University Hospital: Sterling Way, Edmonton, N18 1QX. From Manor House station: ~45 min walk north via Green Lanes and Fore Street, or take bus 259 north towards Edmonton (~25 mins).
- University College Hospital (UCH): 235 Euston Road, NW1 2BU. From Arsenal station / Finsbury Park station: take bus 29 southwest via Camden towards Warren Street (~35 mins).

2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres (UTC):
- Whittington Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Magdala Avenue, N19 5NF (co-located with Whittington Hospital A&E; take bus W7 from Finsbury Park Wells Terrace bus station).
- Hornsey Central NHS Walk-in Centre: 151 Park Road, N8 8JD. From Finsbury Park station: take bus W7 or 41 west towards Muswell Hill (~15 mins).

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- The New River channel passes directly through Finsbury Park and Woodberry Down; localized bank breach or overtopping can cause surface pooling along Green Lanes and Seven Sisters Road.
- Railway underpasses beneath the East Coast Main Line at Stroud Green Road and Wells Terrace are subject to severe rapid flash flooding during heavy rainfall.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
Pharmacies, grocery stores, and larger supermarkets along Seven Sisters Road, Blackstock Road, Stroud Green Road, and Green Lanes provide clean bottled water, baby supplies, and emergency medicines.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
